title: We Tried to Cover a Tom Kean Campaign Event. Someone Called the Police.
summary: Representative Thomas Kean Jr. was joined Friday on the campaign trail by House Speaker Mike Johnson. An aide to Mr. Kean blocked a reporter’s entry. Then the police were called.
